   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 30.05.2026 - 24.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _handysuchtiii_, 18.06.2026, 1/5: "The app crashes a few seconds after I open it."
            2. _katsilt_, 24.08.2026, 2/5: "the app kept crashing no matter what i did"
            3. _𝐀𝐲𝐬𝐞_, 07.08.2026, 2/5: "This app really helped me focus in my study sessions. With this app, every session was productive and I felt kinda sad that the study session was ending HOWEVER if you have 3 friends, you get the pro pass as far as I know and I actually did get the pro pass since I had 3 friends and at the pass, it said that I would be earning golden beans when I completed a study session but I never got them. Also, I had this pass since April and in the Sakura Pass, I got all of the pro stuff so YAY! But in the summer pass, I got the first 2 day’s pro items but then when I clicked on the 3rd day’s pro pass, it told me to get pro. I also have sent an issue about this but they have never replied back to me and it has been a week. I feel terrible writing this review because this app is AMAZING, I will not lie. But I am super duper disappointed and even thought about deleting the app."
